summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study is testing AI-081, a bispecific antibody that targets PD-1 and VEGF, in people with advanced solid tumors. AI-081 is given by IV infusion at a designated dose every 3 weeks (q3w). The study measures the safety, pharmacokinetics (how the drug moves through the body), and efficacy of AI-081.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa AI-081, un anticuerpo biespecífico que actúa contra PD-1 y VEGF, en personas con tumores sólidos avanzados. AI-081 se administra por infusión intravenosa en una dosis designada cada 3 semanas (q3w). El estudio mide la seguridad, la farmacocinética (cómo se distribuye el medicamento en el cuerpo) y la eficacia de AI-081.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older at the time of consent.
ECOG performance status of 1 or better.
Solid tumor that is metastatic or locally advanced.
Adequate organ function and written informed consent.
not_for: Not recovered to grade 1 or lower from side effects of prior cancer treatment (some exceptions listed).
Currently in another investigational trial or receiving other anticancer, immune, or cytokine therapy.
Uncontrolled high blood pressure, recent heart attack or stroke, or LVEF below 40%.
History of interstitial lung disease or non-infectious pneumonitis.
